title: Task

business_result: владелец ведёт связный разговор без перебиваний и слышит русские названия; входящий звонок включает секретаря. Ответ в Matrix/Telegram прекращает цепочку, телефон звонит после подтверждённых пропусков; версии можно повторить и откатить.
current_progress: Latest verified snapshot (2026-10-23): UserIO backend main=origin/main 925a47a; focused checks 20 passed. Owner MatrixRTC history proves two-way Russian audio and Russian product-name pronunciation, but the SDK failed before terminal receipt because effective URL pointed to Airlock Platform. /etc/agentcall-secretary-voice.json now targets SDK app 192.168.128.7:8080; only userio-voice was restarted, no Airlock change. Stable tunnel 127.0.0.1:18086 is absent. Request owner-matrix-secretary-after-sdk-route-20261023-01 returned transport error; no row was found in durable Matrix call store, UserIO DB or backend/voice logs for Oct 23, but dispatcher log is unavailable and both MCP endpoints return transport send error. Its state remains UNKNOWN; do not replay. Escalation contract/runtime match and a confirmed answer stops the chain; Notice Place phone-consumer review is still in progress. BotFather fix db1eeff is on main, head fae2743, focused tests 4/4; existing QA A/B registry is present, no accounts created. Archive audit: Voice image f199406 lacks full release receipt; backend rollback archives b54328f/baa2764 exist; Notice Place runtime revisions differ; BotFather image has no digest/rollback receipt.
external_waits: Authoritative reconciliation of request_id owner-matrix-secretary-after-sdk-route-20261023-01 is pending because dispatcher log is unavailable and both MCP endpoints return transport send error; UNKNOWN must not be replayed. Stable tunnel 127.0.0.1:18086 to SDK app 192.168.128.7:8080 is absent. After those prerequisites, run a separate fresh canary using only existing Matrix fixtures. Notice Place phone-consumer source review is in progress. Real-person/cellular calls are prohibited for testing.
